notes: Upstream-clone bugfix in BurntSushi/ripgrep (v4.2 family): deterministic panic (exit 101) in replace-with-captures when -U/--multiline and -r/--replace combine with a pattern using look-around, giving many short matches. Build/reproduce/patch/verify chain against the real tree with warm caches and 1 vCPU; the panic backtrace points at the source file, so localisation is cheap, but the correct guard requires understanding why the last match can end past range.end and how the replacement range must then be clamped. Verifier: provenance + golden upstream regression test (r3180_look_around_panic, extracted from fix commit at build time) + selection of the project's own multiline/replace integration tests + four authored hidden CLI cases with different inputs/patterns. Oracle applies an authored one-hunk patch.
